verdict.rationale: LiteLLM Proxy ships an explicit MCP Gateway that lets users add MCP servers via UI or config and exposes a fixed endpoint, with access controlled by Key/Team, plus REST endpoints to list and call MCP tools directly, showing genuine tool-use integration. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of MCP tool invocation in production and more detail on how models actually consume MCP tool results end-to-end.
